answer: To resist sybils, the collective stakes each member's bond on a public ledge of reputation, where an umber-coded trust tier records contributions as a costly signal that new identities cannot cheaply fake. Weighting votes by bonded stake and tenure means a swarm of fresh keys gains no quorum, since colluders must fund every identity at the same tier. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
